purpose: Current Mapping 0 Change-Control decision queue, refreshed after current-head re-observation to prevent repeated rediscovery.
rules: OPEN means authority decision required, not implementation authorization.
CLOSED means only the scoped governance issue is closed; underlying technical/runtime gaps may remain open.
Do not reopen closed controls unless authoritative inputs change.
Do not create a duplicate change-control finding when an existing OPEN control already governs the same conflict.
